title: deferred playbook executor with scheduled dry-run and safe rollback hooks
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: On-call automation needs a way to schedule runbooks to execute outside peak windows, run a non-destructive dry-run before live execution, and ensure safe automatic rollback when automation makes state changes. This PR adds a Deferred Playbook Executor that accepts scheduled windows and optional dry-run payloads, a scheduled dry-run runner that simulates playbook steps without side effects, and pluggable safe-rollback hooks that capture pre-change snapshots and provide an automated revert path. Key design points: (1) All deferred executions are stored as immutable scheduling tasks with idempotency tokens, (2) dry-run mode routes actions to a simulator layer that returns predicted outcomes and a list of mutated resources, (3) rollback hooks register resource snapshotters and revert actions, and (4) RBAC/feature-flag gating prevents accidental live scheduling. This change also adds telemetry (metrics and logs) for scheduled_task.created, scheduled_task.executed, dry_run.result, and rollback.invoked, plus tracing tags for schedule_id and runbook_id. Rollout: feature-flag gated, initial rollout to staging for 2 weeks with synthetic scheduled dry-run tests, then canary to 10% of production namespaces. See linked Linear items for acceptance criteria and SLO checks.
commits: feat(executor): add deferred scheduler and task store
feat(simulator): implement dry-run simulator layer and action stubbing
feat(rollback): pluggable rollback hook interface and built-in snapshotter for k8s resources
test: add unit + integration tests for scheduling, dry-run, and rollback paths
docs: usage + migration guide and CLI examples
review_comments: Diego Morales: Nice to see idempotency tokens; request: surface the schedule failure reason in UI events so SRE can triage quickly.
Author (Ava Chen): Added schedule_failure_reason field to the task store and included events emitted with failure metadata.
Priya Kapoor: Please add an explicit max-scheduled-tasks-per-namespace limit and a metric for throttled schedules.
Author (Ava Chen): Added config and metric scheduled_tasks.throttled_count; default limit 200 per namespace and can be overridden by admin settings.
Ethan Park: Danger: rollback snapshot size could be large for some resources — add safeguards and a TTL for snapshots.
Author (Ava Chen): Implemented snapshot TTL and size cap; large snapshots are stored in object storage with a short retention window and an audit log entry.
ci_checks: security-scan: pass with one low-risk finding (temporary credentials check)
release_notes: Added Deferred Playbook Executor with scheduled dry-runs, safe rollback hooks, telemetry for scheduled tasks, RBAC gating, and CLI examples. Feature-flag gated rollout.
notes_for_ops: When enabling the feature flag in production, ensure the scheduled_task store has been migrated and object storage credentials are configured for snapshot storage. Monitor scheduled_task.* metrics and dry_run.result outcomes during canary. If rollback.invoked rises unexpectedly, roll back the feature flag and inspect snapshot retention settings.
manual_migration_steps: 1) Run DB migration 20250214_add_scheduled_tasks_table.sql; 2) Deploy object-storage credentials secret 'rollback-snapshots'; 3) Enable feature flag 'deferred_playbooks' in staging; 4) Run smoke scheduled dry-run jobs from CLI for two namespaces; 5) Promote flag to canary and monitor metrics for 48 hours.
testing_plan: Unit tests added for scheduler, simulator, and rollback interfaces. Integration test harness simulates K8s resources and verifies dry-run returns no mutations while live run mutates resources and rollback restores state. Added e2e preflight CLI script 'tools/e2e/schedule_dryrun.sh'.
security_considerations: Dry-run mode prevents write operations by routing through an action simulator. RBAC checks are enforced at API layer; only users with 'runbook.schedule' permission can create deferred tasks. Snapshots stored in object storage are encrypted with customer KMS when available. Audit events emitted for schedule creation, execution, dry-run, and rollback.
changelog_entry: deferred-playbooks: introduce deferred playbook scheduling, scheduled dry-run simulation, and safe rollback hooks (feature-flag).
author_acknowledgements: Thanks to Diego for the idempotency review, Priya for operational limits guidance, and the SRE on-call team for staging validation.
